params.caption: 🎮 Umamusume owner CyberAgent plans seven new games by 2030 CyberAgent, parent company of Umamusume: Pretty Derby developer Cygames, used its latest quarterly earnings presentation to celebrate its mobile success, claiming an "88 percent hit rate" on its mobile titles.
